claim_or_equation: MC closure may authorize detector performance
assumptions: MC and reconstruction can share assumptions
notes: Closure values remain useful as method/model diagnostics but cannot be promoted to measured detector performance.

claim_or_equation: timewalk phenomenology must have correct sign/domain
primary_reference_or_derivation: derive/cite electronics discriminator/timewalk response and validate on data
assumptions: pulse family stable; amplitude estimator physical
expected_sign_or_bounds: correction sign must match observed walk
independent_falsifier: held-out amplitude/run monotonicity and residual slope
notes: Historical toy-digitizer timewalk tension is a known warning.

expected_sign_or_bounds: visible response monotonic; quenching reduces response at high dE/dx
independent_falsifier: alternative kB/material nuisance and bench/data anchor
notes: Exact Geant4 implementation and parameter units must be verified before use.

primary_reference_or_derivation: derive from point-process model; authoritative reference required
assumptions: stationary independent arrivals unless shown otherwise
independent_falsifier: beam-current scan and alternate live-time definitions
notes: Distinct Rmax definitions must not be conflated.

claim_or_equation: Birks saturation as implemented in Geant4
primary_reference_or_derivation: Geant4 Book for Application Developers: Birks Quenching; Physics Reference/Book sections for G4EmSaturation
assumptions: Birks is phenomenological; effective coefficient depends on delta-ray treatment/production threshold and exact material implementation
expected_sign_or_bounds: quenching reduces visible response relative to unquenched deposit at high ionization density
independent_falsifier: vary production cuts/kB and compare to independent detector response
notes: Do not treat fitted MC kB as a measured detector constant. Geant4 documentation explicitly warns that the coefficient is simulation-threshold dependent.

units: MeV cm2/g and range units per PSTAR
primary_reference_or_derivation: NIST PSTAR; methods based on ICRU Report 49
assumptions: material composition/density and energy must match; PSTAR is for protons, not a direct deuteron reference
validity_domain: proton kinetic-energy domain and selected material
expected_sign_or_bounds: reference interpolation must remain within table domain and preserve physical monotonic/finite behavior
independent_falsifier: compare accepted projectile total-loss observable; reject deuteron E/2 proxy as accepting evidence
notes: PSTAR calculates proton stopping powers and ranges. Any deuteron mapping remains diagnostic unless independently validated.

claim_or_equation: S13360-3050CS properties must be operating-point specific
primary_reference_or_derivation: Hamamatsu S13360-3050CS product page and datasheet
parameter_provenance: datasheet plus actual detector bias/temperature records
assumptions: gain/PDE/dark count/crosstalk depend on operating conditions; manufacturer typical values are not detector calibration
expected_sign_or_bounds: 3x3 mm active area and 50 um pitch are design properties; response parameters vary with overvoltage and temperature
notes: Manufacturer page lists 3600 pixels and typical gain 1.7e6 at stated conditions; exact PDE/crosstalk/noise used in MC still require detector-specific evidence.

claim_or_equation: Y-11 optical response must use matching fibre type/measurement conditions
primary_reference_or_derivation: Kuraray wavelength-shifting-fibre product and technical pages
parameter_provenance: hardware BOM plus manufacturer/lot or measured fibre data
assumptions: manufacturer spectral/attenuation values are representative and condition dependent; attenuation is not a universal single number at all distances
expected_sign_or_bounds: blue-to-green wavelength shifting and distance-dependent attenuation
independent_falsifier: bench attenuation and timing measurement with installed geometry
notes: Kuraray explicitly labels presented values representative/not guaranteed; detector coupling and installed-fibre response must be measured or nuisance-varied.

claim_or_equation: uniform CM-angle sampling is not an accepted quantitative p+d differential cross section
primary_reference_or_derivation: authoritative energy-appropriate p+d dσ/dΩ reference still to be bound
assumptions: quantitative stopping/acceptance predictions require physically supported angular weighting at the beam energy
validity_domain: beam/target reaction energy and angular domain
expected_sign_or_bounds: generated angular distribution should reproduce accepted differential-cross-section shape within uncertainty
independent_falsifier: replace uniform sampling with authoritative dσ/dΩ and quantify downstream response
notes: Keep quantitative stopping/PID transfer blocked until the scattering model is justified and sensitivity propagated.
